verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out or data-use policy is a fair question for any SaaS platform that holds customer data, including an identity and device management service like JumpCloud, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use policies, or opt-out controls; the items cover only SSO, MFA, MDM, RADIUS, automation and directory features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
